name: randombit/botan
description: A comprehensive C++ cryptography library released under BSD-2 covering TLS, X.509 PKI, AEAD ciphers, hardware support (PKCS#11, TPM), and post-quantum cryptography with a clean modern API.
score_rationale: Solid C++ cryptographic library with 3.2k stars and a March 2026 release (3.11.0), offering broad algorithm coverage including emerging post-quantum schemes.
